entries.title: Psalms 111:1
segments: Praise the LORD! I will praise the LORD with all [my] heart, in the council of the upright, and of the congregation.

entries.title: Psalms 111:2
segments: The works of the LORD [are] great, sought out by all those who have pleasure in them.

entries.title: Psalms 111:3
segments: His work [is] honorable and glorious; and His righteousness [is] standing forever.

entries.title: Psalms 111:4
segments: He has made His wonderful works to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and full of pity.

entries.title: Psalms 111:5
segments: He has given food to those who fear Him; He will always be mindful of His covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 111:6
segments: He has shown His people the power of His works, to give to them the inheritance of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 111:7
segments: The works of His hands [are] truth and judgment; all His commands [are] true,

entries.title: Psalms 111:8
segments: standing fast forever and ever; [they are] done in truth and uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 111:9
segments: He sent redemption to His people; He has commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome [is] His name.

entries.title: Psalms 111:10
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom; all practicing them [have] good understanding; His praise stands forever.
